background: Lloyds Bank Corporate Markets is the non-ring-fenced bank of Lloyds Banking Group, housing its markets business, its Crown Dependency banking and lending to larger corporates outside the ring-fence, funded by corporate deposits and wholesale markets.
synthesis: Ratings are AA from Fitch after the upgrade on 12 May 2026, A from S&P and A1 from Moody's, all stable, resting on the group. Capital is mixed against UK majors: CET1 of 13.5% is a little under the peer median, while leverage of 8.0% is in the top quarter against 4.9%. Liquidity is strong, with LCR of 173% in the top quarter and NSFR of 134% above the peer median, though NSFR has fallen 11 points since 30 Jun 2024. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days. A well-supported entity carrying plenty of plain capital for its size.
